ownership.plant: Basilisk owns truth propagation and synthetic observation generation.
ownership.preprocessing: Sensor managers own units, calibration, mounting and acquisition/quality provenance.
ownership.references: Separate provider uses declared orbit/position estimate and ephemeris/field model at acquisition epoch; no truth attitude.
ownership.estimator: Gyro propagation, local correction, bias/covariance, history and quality only.
ownership.controller: Explicit consumer-epoch and mode permission policy; no automatic authority from an available quaternion.
ownership.independent_evaluator: Synthetic plant truth or separately calibrated tracker/test truth; never undisclosed estimator correction.

frame_contract.N: Existing Earth-centered ICRF/J2000 simulation inertial frame.
frame_contract.P: Existing low-order Earth-fixed/planet-fixed frame; Earth model unchanged.
frame_contract.B: Right-handed mathematical body frame; physical HS-2 mapping/origin TBD.
frame_contract.attitude: q_BN and sigma_BN represent C_BN, N to B.
frame_contract.WMM: r_P = C_PN r_N; B_N = transpose(C_PN) B_P
frame_contract.sensor: v_Sm = C_SmB C_BN B_N; v_B = transpose(C_SmB) v_Sm
frame_contract.sun: reconstruct body direction from calibrated valid CSS intensities and surveyed normals

mathematics.interpretation: Symbolic candidate model. Algebra validated for the stated convention; no installed stochastic parameters.
mathematics.bias_model: b_true_dot=n_b; residual random walk is ASSUMED and requires characterization
mathematics.spectral_model: Qc positive semidefinite; diag(S_g,S_b) only under an explicit independence assumption
mathematics.tangent_basis: E^T*E=I2; E^T*uhat=0; E has dimension 3 by 2
mathematics.sensor_R_term: E^T*J_norm*R_raw_B*J_norm^T*E; reference/systematic/correlated terms require explicit treatment
mathematics.antipodal_guard: Use full angle atan2(|cross(y,uhat)|,dot(y,uhat)); tangent residual is zero for y=-uhat and cannot authorize local correction.
mathematics.gain: S=H*P_minus*H^T+R; K=P_minus*H^T*S^(-1); implementation should solve without explicit inverse
mathematics.reset: Gamma=diag(Jr(a),I); P_plus=Gamma*Pe*Gamma^T; reset error mean to zero
mathematics.normalization: Reject nonfinite/zero quaternion; normalize without reducing P; internal sign continuity.
mathematics.MRP: Choose q0>=0; sigma=qv/(1+q0); shadow=-sigma/dot(sigma,sigma) for nonzero sigma.

current_timing_facts.source: current scenario/magnetic-cycle files, hashes in baseline.source_files; Phase 7A T04
current_timing_facts.applicability: Existing simulation/test-only settings, not new flight requirements; not changed.

timing_contract.propagation: Use gyro packet support and physical acquisition time; distinguish point rate, interval average and delta angle. Map monotonic time to the environment epoch explicitly.
timing_contract.reference_epoch: Evaluate each inertial reference at its observation epoch.
timing_contract.delayed_event: Restore preceding checkpoint, propagate to acquisition, insert update, replay all subsequent gyro and measurement events chronologically.
timing_contract.replay_policy: Preserve external validity; specify deterministic innovation-gate re-evaluation and original/revised dispositions, stable same-epoch order, deduplication and lineage.
timing_contract.unsupported_events: Explicit rejection/status for future clock, outside history or missing gyro coverage; do not relabel as current.
timing_contract.asynchronous_acquisition: Prefer a common-epoch pair. If justified gyro transport is available, pair transported observation at t0 with its original u_N(ti), retaining transport uncertainty and correlations.
timing_contract.output: State epoch separate from receipt/publication and last aiding ages. No retroactive change to commands.
timing_contract.control_compatibility: Future cycle facade must freeze posterior sample-epoch rate/attitude paired with sampled B if retaining existing control contract; a current-state output is a separate product.

modes.response: One vector cannot fully initialize absolute attitude; expose status without changing rate-based detumble.
Two instantaneous attitude constraints; rotation about B unobserved; temporal bias observability depends on geometry/dynamics.
Roll about Sun unobserved; insufficient CSS geometry may also invalidate reconstruction.

modes.inputs: two noncollinear valid vector pairs + gyro
modes.response: Local attitude rank three; bias requires time/excitation; near-collinearity ill-conditioned.

modes.inputs: gyro and valid quiet magnetic, if available
modes.response: No fake zero Sun update; use single-vector or gyro-only state, no implicit tracker aiding.

modes.inputs: valid gyro coverage and initialized prior
modes.response: Propagate only; bias unobservable without aids; report age/model limitation.

modes.inputs: no credible prior or outside local basin
modes.response: Wait for valid two-vector acquisition or approved prior; no arbitrary identity marked initialized.
Estimate availability is not pointing capability; LOST excluded, FOUND downstream, tracker independent.
Reject invalid inputs with reasons; missing gyro coverage prevents fresh propagation absent separately validated fallback.

initialization.attitude: Valid noncollinear two-vector solution or explicit credible prior, with known frame/time support.
initialization.bias: Separate calibrated prior and P0; TRIAD does not instantly determine bias.
initialization.synthetic_cases: Zero initial bias or supplied perfect attitude prior only in explicitly labeled test cases, never hidden truth initialization.
initialization.reacquisition: Distinguish invalid measurement, bad geometry and invalid local prior; use full angular discrepancy; explicit bias/P0 disposition and reset lineage.

pointing_boundary.combination: Use frame/boresight/time Jacobians with a justified full covariance; keep systematic bounds and confidence differences separate. Prevent double counting.
pointing_boundary.restriction: No scalar RSS, flight P confidence, own-estimator accuracy or pointing performance claim.

validation.scope: Mathematical fixtures only; not a running estimator or scenario.

mathematical_checks.independent_anchor: nonidentity rotations and equal-norm wrong direction
known rotation recovery and exact degeneracy
moving inertial reference and body transform
zero tangent residual with pi angular error

validation.limitations: No full MEKF convergence, replay manager, CSS reconstruction, sensor realism, detumble rerun or flight accuracy verification.
validation.fixture_policy: All numerical test angles, intervals, SPD matrices and tolerances are synthetic algebra fixtures, not HS-2 parameters or flight Q/R/gates.

steps: Review decisions and freeze isolated synthetic interface/convention.
Implement and test propagation, TRIAD and local MEKF kernels.
Implement chronological events/history; delayed replay includes later measurements; test duplicates and coverage.
Verify acquisition, observable bias cases, null modes, dropouts and covariance integrity against independent truth.
Keep truth out of estimator inputs and ordinary initialization.
Use labeled synthetic nonsingular algebra weights or a justified deterministic constrained solver; noise-free data is not permission for a singular zero-covariance Kalman solve.
Design later Basilisk facade only after isolated checks and explicit authorization; preserve sample-epoch control contract.
Close U01-U11 before installed performance, stochastic consistency or pointing claims.
